description: This file defines the LiveListenerBus class in Apache Spark, responsible for asynchronously passing SparkListenerEvents to registered SparkListeners, managing event queues, starting/stopping event processing, and tracking metrics related to listener events.

classes.name: LiveListenerBus
classes.description: Manages asynchronous event delivery to SparkListeners, including queue management, starting/stopping, and event posting.

classes.name: LiveListenerBusMetrics
classes.description: Tracks metrics related to the LiveListenerBus, such as total events posted and processing time per listener class.

methods.name: addToSharedQueue
methods.description: Adds a listener to the shared event queue.

methods.name: addToManagementQueue
methods.description: Adds a listener to the executor management event queue.

methods.name: addToStatusQueue
methods.description: Adds a listener to the application status event queue.

methods.name: addToEventLogQueue
methods.description: Adds a listener to the event log queue.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Adds a listener to a specific queue, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from all queues it was added to.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts an event to all queues, buffering if not started.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the event delivery, processing buffered events and registering metrics.

methods.name: waitUntilEmpty
methods.description: Waits until all event queues are empty or timeout occurs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event delivery, waiting for queues to process remaining events.

methods.name: findListenersByClass
methods.description: Finds listeners of a specific class (testing only).

methods.name: activeQueues
methods.description: Returns the set of active queue names (testing only).

methods.name: getQueueCapacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of a specified queue (testing only).
